playArea.value: A radioactive atom with jiggling nucleons sits in the center. You can watch it decay, observe how the nucleus changes, and reset the atom to repeat your experiment. A timeline shows the moment of each decay relative to half-life. An energy diagram shows the potential energy barrier and alpha particle energy. With a custom isotope, you can experiment with the barrier height, initial energy, and half-life.

controlArea.value: You can replay the last decay and control how fast the action happens. Reset sim to start over.

noAtom.value: Currently no atom in the play area.

readyToDecayLastDecay.value: {{isotope}} ready to decay. Last decay, {{decayTime}} seconds.
